title: Queen City Dance Festival 2026
description:
Queen City Dance Festival 2026
Join us in Charlotte, NC for the Queen City Dance Festival (QCDF) 2026, an exciting SBKZ festival bringing you the full experience of Salsa, Bachata, Kizomba, Konpa, Urbankiz, BZouk, Chicago Stepping, Detroit Ballroom and more!!!
Held at the Hilton Charlotte Airport, QCDF is going BIG for 2026! This four-day celebration of dance features some of the most talented artists and performers in the industry. Each day is filled with immersive workshops, inspiring performances, unforgettable day and night parties that keep the energy going into the early morning hours.
Once you experience the Queen City Dance Festival, it’s sure to become one of the premier dance events you look forward to each year in the vibrant Queen City!
If you’ve always wanted to learn how to dance, this is the perfect beginning. If you are looking to improve and advance your techniques, Queen City Dance Festival offers classes for beginners, challenges for the advanced, and everything in between. Come learn from the best in the world and our local community has to offer and enjoy the Queen City Dance Festival (QCDF) 2026!!
QUEEN CITY DANCE FESTIVAL
====================================
4 Days of BEGINNER BOOTCAMPS (Salsa & Bachata, Kizomba & Konpa & Semba, Urbankiz & Zouk)
4 Days of WORKSHOPS (For all levels, Beginners to Advanced)
4 Nights of PERFORMANCES (Amateur to World Pro Dancers)
4 Nights of Theme Parties till 5am!
5 Dance rooms, each with a different style:
* Salsa Room (Salsa, ChaChaCha, Timba, Mambo)
* ⁠Bachata Room (Sensual & Dominican Bachata)
* Kizomba/Konpa Room (Kizomba, Konpa, Semba, Afrohouse)
* Urbankiz/BZouk Room (Ghetto-Zouk, Brazilian Zouk, Tarraxinha, and remixes with R&B)
* ⁠Chicago Stepping/Detroit Ballroom (R&B, Soul, Jazz-funk, and Neo-soul)
